tacticalIdentity: Beast handler who fields companion units. Wins by overwhelming the opponent with coordinated multi-unit pressure from companions that act independently each turn. The beasts are the frontline; the Faunamancer is a command-and-control unit that stays in the rear.
designNotes: AP must cover both personal actions and beast commands. Scout Wolf and Siege Boar are the core companions. Max 3 companions active.

baseSpells.description: Marks a single enemy unit. All allied companion units gain +2 damage against the marked target and prioritize attacking it when within range.
baseSpells.designNotes: 1 AP setup. All companions focus-fire the marked target for bonus damage. Combine with Siege Boar charge for burst.

baseSpells.description: A rallying cry that grants all allied units within range +1 movement for 1 turn and removes SLOWED. Companions within range may make an immediate free reaction move.
baseSpells.designNotes: Formation rally. All allies including companions gain movement. Removes SLOWED for coordinated advance.

baseSpells.description: Heightens the Faunamancer or a chosen ally's tracking instincts, granting TREMORSENSE (can sense all units within 4 tiles ignoring LoS and concealment) for 2 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: 1 AP scouting tool. Grants LoS-bypass detection for 2 turns.

baseSpells.description: Summons a beast companion from the wild at the target location. Faunamancer can call a Scout Wolf (fast, high move), a Siege Boar (slow, high HP, charge ability), or a Raptor (medium stats, flanking bonus).
baseSpells.designNotes: Core summon spell. Up to 3 companion units active at once. Choose companion type based on current tactical need.

baseSpells.description: Establishes an instinctual predator link between an allied unit and one of the Faunamancer's active companion units. When either bonded unit attacks, the other may perform a free reaction attack against the same target if in range. Both bonded units gain +1 damage against enemies who have attacked either of them. Duration: 3 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Dual-threat reaction mechanic. Bond break FRENZY punishes the counterplay of killing the companion.
